annotations.title: Plan the pages of an architecture or interior design studio website

description: Lists the pages an architecture or interior design studio website needs, in the order a client meets them, with what goes on each page, plus the section-by-section structure of a project page. Use when an architect, interior designer or their web designer asks what pages a studio website should have, how to structure a portfolio, or what a project page should include.

journal.description: Whether the studio will write about its work a few times a year. Default false.

project_count.description: How many projects the studio wants to show on the site. Default 6.

studio_type.description: What the studio designs: buildings (architecture), interiors, or both. Default both.
